title: RC 充放电：用方波看时间常数
summary: 0–5 V 方波经 10 kΩ 给 100 nF 电容充放电：改变频率，看电容电压在半个周期里能走多远，再从曲线读出 τ。
concepts: time constant τ = RC 时间常数
charging / discharging 充电 / 放电
description: 信号发生器（方波 0 ↔ 5 V）→ R1（10 kΩ）→ 结点 VC → C1（100 nF）→ GND。CH1 看输入，CH2 看 VC。

cards.title: 让电容一遍遍充满、放空
text: - 信号发生器是**方波**，在 0 和 5 V 之间跳：高电平像“合上开关给电容充电”，低电平像“拨到地让它放电”。
- 把频率调到 **`50 Hz`**，看 CH2（电容）的形状；再试 **`5 kHz`**。
电容电压是一下子跳上去的吗？频率高了以后，它还充得满吗？

cards.title: 先快后慢：时间常数 τ
text: - 刚开始充电时电容是空的，电阻两端的电压最大，电流最大，所以升得快。越接近 5 V，电阻上剩下的电压越小，电流越小，升得越慢。
- 快慢只由一个数决定，叫**时间常数**。R 要算上信号发生器的 50 Ω：
- 每过一个 τ，离终点的距离就只剩约 37%：1τ 走完 63%，3τ 走完 95%，5τ 几乎走完。
![](fig:tau)
- 所以要比的是**半个周期和 τ**：半个周期 ≫ τ，每次都充满、放空；差不多长，充不满就开始放；半个周期 ≪ τ，只走了曲线最开头的一小段，像一个小三角波。
![](fig:half)

cards.title: 从曲线读出 τ
text: - **`50 Hz`** 时读 CH2 的上升时间：电容电压从 10% 升到 90% 用的时间。
- 指数曲线从 10% 到 90% 正好要 τ × ln 9 ≈ 2.2τ，所以 τ = 上升时间 / ln 9。
- 再调到 **`500 Hz`** 读 CH2 的峰峰值，最后看一眼 **`5 kHz`** 的形状。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **τ = RC**：电阻、电容越大，充放得越慢。信号发生器的 50 Ω 也在 R 里。
- **半个周期 ≫ τ** 时每次充满放空；**≪ τ** 时只剩一个小三角波，骑在平均值上。
- **真实电路里**：瓷片电容的误差常有 ±10%～±20%，量出的 τ 和算的差一两成很正常。反过来，量 τ 就能测出电容的真实值。

caption.text: 从 0 开始充电：横轴按 τ 计。1τ 到 63%，3τ 到 95%，5τ 几乎到顶。

i18n.en: Charging from 0, time counted in τ: 63 % at 1τ, 95 % at 3τ, nearly all the way at 5τ.

caption.text: 半个周期差不多是一个 τ：电容充不满就开始放电，稳定后在两个电平之间来回，中心是 2.5 V。

i18n.en: Half a period about one τ: the capacitor starts emptying before it is full, and settles to swinging between two levels around 2.5 V.

en.title: RC charging: seeing the time constant with a square wave
en.summary: A 0–5 V square wave charges and discharges 100 nF through 10 kΩ: change the frequency, see how far the capacitor voltage gets in half a period, and read τ off the curve.
en.description: Generator (square 0 ↔ 5 V) → R1 (10 kΩ) → node VC → C1 (100 nF) → GND. CH1 on the input, CH2 on VC.
en.compare:
**Compare**: τ = (10 kΩ + 50 Ω) × 100 nF ≈ **1.0 ms**; rise time t_r = τ·ln 9 ≈ **2.2 ms**.
- **50 Hz**: half a period, 10 ms, ≈ 10τ. Nearly full to 5 V and empty to 0 V every time.
- **500 Hz**: half a period, 1 ms, ≈ τ. It settles between about 1.35 V and 3.65 V; Vpp = 5 × tanh(T / 4τ) ≈ **2.3 V**.
- **5 kHz**: half a period, 0.1 ms, = 0.1τ; only a **triangle** of about 0.25 Vpp is left, riding on 2.5 V.

Where the tanh comes from: in steady state the charging half gives VH = 5 − (5 − VL)·e^(−T/2τ) and the discharging half VL = VH·e^(−T/2τ); together VH − VL = 5·tanh(T/4τ).
hints: R1 from the generator's column (column 3) to column 10; C1 from column 10 to the GND rail.
The scope's rise-time reading is the 10 %→90 % time.
τ = t_r / ln 9; at 500 Hz half a period is about one τ.
tests: 50 Hz (half a period ≫ τ): the capacitor fills and empties every time
500 Hz (half a period ≈ τ): never full, swinging around the centre
5 kHz (half a period ≪ τ): only a small triangle left

measurements.ask: 50 Hz: CH2's rise time t_r (10 % to 90 %)
From your t_r, the time constant τ = t_r / ln 9
measurements.explain: An exponential takes τ·ln 9 ≈ 2.2τ from 10 % to 90 %. τ = (10 kΩ + 50 Ω) × 100 nF ≈ 1.0 ms.
Half a period ≈ τ, the capacitor can't fill: Vpp = 5 V × tanh(T / 4τ) ≈ 2.3 V.

measurements.ask: At 5 kHz, what does CH2 look like?
measurements.explain: Half a period, 0.1 ms, is only 0.1τ: each half covers just the nearly straight start of the curve. The centre is the square wave's average, 2.5 V.
choices: a very small triangle riding on about 2.5 V
a square wave like the input

cards.title: Fill and empty a capacitor, again and again
text: - The generator and two probes are already on the board. Add **R1 `10 kΩ`** (**`b3`** → **`b10`**) and **C1 `100 nF`** (**`c10`** → the GND rail).
- The generator gives a **square wave** jumping between 0 and 5 V: the high level is like closing a switch to charge the capacitor, the low level like switching to ground to discharge it.
- Set **`50 Hz`** and look at the shape on CH2 (the capacitor); then try **`5 kHz`**.
Does the capacitor voltage jump straight up? At the higher frequency, does it still fill up?

cards.title: Fast, then slower: the time constant τ
text: - At the start the capacitor is empty, the resistor has the most voltage across it and the current is largest, so it rises fast. The nearer it gets to 5 V, the less is left across the resistor, the smaller the current, the slower the rise.
- One number sets the pace, the **time constant**. R includes the generator's 50 Ω:
- Each τ leaves only about 37 % of the remaining distance: 63 % done after 1τ, 95 % after 3τ, practically all after 5τ.
![](fig:tau)

- So compare **half a period with τ**: much longer, and it fills and empties every time; about equal, and it starts emptying before it is full; much shorter, and it only covers the very start of the curve — a small triangle.
![](fig:half)

cards.title: Read τ off the curve
text: - At **`50 Hz`** read CH2's rise time: how long the capacitor voltage takes from 10 % to 90 %.
- An exponential takes exactly τ × ln 9 ≈ 2.2τ from 10 % to 90 %, so τ = rise time / ln 9.
- Then set **`500 Hz`** and read CH2's peak-to-peak; finally look at the shape at **`5 kHz`**.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **τ = RC**: the larger R and C, the slower the charging. The generator's 50 Ω is part of R.
- **1τ 63 %, 3τ 95 %, 5τ about 99 %**: in practice 5τ counts as "full".
- **Half a period ≫ τ**: full charge and discharge every time; **≪ τ**: only a small triangle riding on the average.
- **In a real circuit**: ceramic capacitors are often ±10–20 %, so a measured τ 10–20 % off the calculation is normal. Turned around, measuring τ tells you the capacitor's real value.

tests.name: 50 Hz（半个周期 ≫ τ）：电容每次都充满、放空
500 Hz（半个周期 ≈ τ）：来不及充满，围绕中心来回
5 kHz（半个周期 ≪ τ）：只剩一个小三角波

compare:
**对比**：τ = (10 kΩ + 50 Ω) × 100 nF ≈ **1.0 ms**；上升时间 t_r = τ·ln 9 ≈ **2.2 ms**。
- **50 Hz**：半个周期 10 ms ≈ 10τ。每次几乎充满到 5 V、放空到 0 V。
- **500 Hz**：半个周期 1 ms ≈ τ。稳定后在约 1.35 V 和 3.65 V 之间来回，Vpp = 5 × tanh(T / 4τ) ≈ **2.3 V**。
- **5 kHz**：半个周期 0.1 ms = 0.1τ，只剩一个约 0.25 Vpp 的**三角波**，骑在 2.5 V 上。

tanh 公式的来历：稳态时充电半周期 VH = 5 − (5 − VL)·e^(−T/2τ)，放电半周期 VL = VH·e^(−T/2τ)，两式联立得 VH − VL = 5·tanh(T/4τ)。

measurements.ask: 50 Hz：CH2 的上升时间 t_r（从 10% 升到 90%）
由你读的 t_r 算时间常数 τ = t_r / ln 9
measurements.explain: 指数曲线从 10% 到 90% 正好要 τ·ln 9 ≈ 2.2τ。τ = (10 kΩ + 50 Ω) × 100 nF ≈ 1.0 ms。
半个周期 ≈ τ，电容来不及充满：Vpp = 5 V × tanh(T / 4τ) ≈ 2.3 V。

measurements.ask: 5 kHz 时，CH2 是什么样子？
choices: 一个很小的三角波，骑在约 2.5 V 上
一条停在 5 V 的直线
measurements.explain: 半个周期 0.1 ms 只有 0.1τ：每次只走了曲线开头几乎是直线的一小段。中心是方波的平均值 2.5 V。

hints: R1 从信号发生器那一列（第 3 列）接到第 10 列；C1 从第 10 列接到 GND 轨。
示波器的上升时间读数就是 10%→90% 的时间。
τ = t_r / ln 9；500 Hz 时半个周期大约是一个 τ。
